summary: AstroVitals is a space-mission health monitoring prototype, designed to support & improve astronauts wellbeing during their voyages. Their main challenges are isolation, microgravity, radiation and limited medical support. AstroVirdstals addresses those hazards in a smart modern way. The platform allows users to store health indicators, track personal baselines and trends. On the other hand, rule -based alerts with guidance are received. An interactive 3D human body helps astronauts to explore health-related information. AstroVitals turns every records into understandable insights. Mission journalism feature lets users to turn their memories into words. All these features are intended to support their informed-decision-making in health during missions. It is a prototype, not a clinically validated diagnostic system.
details:
AstroVitals is a health- monitoring platform designed for astronauts during space missions. Users can record health information and track changes over time.

An interactive 3D human body model allows users to select body regions and explore related health information: 'How to measure, Why it matters, Spaceflight hazards,When to escalate, What to do'. Mission tasks and achievements encourage regular health check-ins.

The system compares recorded health metrices with personal baseline and uses rule-based checks to identify unusual changes. It displays health alerts and appropriate guidance. The "Trend" section helps astronauts understand their health information and notice possible health concerns.

Mission journaling enables astronauts to record their emotions, challenges, and experiences, helping to reduce feelings of isolation during long-duration missions. NASA and CSA resources support space health awareness, while AstroVitals generates alerts using rule-based assessments.

Technologies used:

  • Frontend: React.js, JavaScript and CSS3
  • Backend: Java 17 and Spring Boot
  • Database: MySQL and H2
  • 3D visualization: Three.js, React Three Fiber and React Three Drei
  • Communication: REST APIs
The Strategy Design Pattern was implemented using Java.

AstroVitals is forward-thinking because it brings health tracking, alerts, mission journaling, and 3D visualization together in one platform. We considered space health risks, usability, clear information display, user engagement, and data privacy when designing the system.

This prototype does not use live medical sensors or clinically validated assessments.

AI assistance was used for brainstorming, research, and code debugging. The team reviewed all suggestions and made the final design and implementation decisions.
